messages:
maria: kicking off percent bump to v3.2.1 -> 15% in eu-west (11:30 PT). 20m warmup, stop/go at 11:50 PT. watch latency, kv-cache, and embed quality. changelog: https://redwood.internal/rel/3.2.1 :eyes:

alex: ack. I'll watch tail latency and error-rate dashboards. ping me for rollback if 5xx spike > 0.5% or p99 > 250ms.

jordan: quick q — is the canary pinned to quantized 4-bit or float on this ring? want to confirm mem pressure expectations.

maria: pinned to q4_0 for eu-west small pool. fallback plan is float32 variant in same version.

priya: posting the smoke prompt set results now. small drift on embedding norm (~2.7% change). not catastrophic but keep an eye on rerank tests.

ops-bot: metrics snapshot (automated): 
- qps: 120 -> 135 (15% bump)
- p50: 58ms, p95: 180ms, p99: 240ms
- 5xx rate: 0.12%
- kv-cache free: 72%

(see dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/rollouts/7954321001)

deploy-bot: rollout progress: 15% target applied to eu-west on v3.2.1. Autodrain: OFF. Canary checks enabled.

alex: seeing a tiny uptick in p99 on a subset of routes hitting external rerank service. investigating.

maria: note: readme says to prefer 60s idle-kv-ttl for q4_0; infra already set to 60s.

jordan: re: pinning — if we see mem jitter we should pin affected routes to float32 variant and keep rest on q4. can we do a partial pin?

priya: yes, we have per-route pinning. I'll prepare a pin manifest if needed: 
```yaml
route: /v1/chat/embed
pin: v3.2.1-float32
percent: 5
reason: rerank-latency
```

maria: update: alex reports p99 trending to 340ms on 1 host group, 5xx still low. alex, do you want a stop or continue? :thinking_face:

alex: suggest pause at 15% while we confirm rerank latency source. canary holds if p99 > 300ms on >3% of hosts for 10m.

deploy-bot: hold executed. rollout paused at 15%. Automated health checks failed: one host group p99 breach.

ops-bot: note: scaling events seen on the small-pool due to background GC from quantized kernel warmup. CPU burst ~82% for those pods.

maria: thanks. we're pausing to avoid cascading. priya, can you trigger per-route pin for /v1/chat/embed to float32 5% as a safety?

priya: on it. applying pin now.

deploy-bot: applied pin manifest for /v1/chat/embed -> v3.2.1-float32 at 5%.

alex: after pin, p99 on affected hosts dropped to 190ms, overall p99 back to 210ms. 5xx unchanged. looks good.

jordan: nice. recommends holding the pause for another 10m to watch for regression cascade.

maria: agree. We keep pause, no rollback. we'll reconvene at 11:50 PT or earlier if something changes. :thumbsup:

priya: logging the decision in release notes channel and tagging infra for follow-up on q4 kernel warmup.

maria: final call for now: STOP -> hold at 15% and monitor. If clean for next 15m we will resume to 40% with a smaller ramp.

alex: ack. I'll stay on watch.

deploy-bot: thread closed by hold decision. resume command pending manual approval.

maria: thanks everyone — great quick turnaround.
